attributes.board_name: Alabama Board of Examiners in Counseling

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by NBCC, CRCC, NAADAC, ASCA, APA or the Alabama Department of Mental Health; formal graduate academic coursework; up to 10 hours for two of: presenting, peer-reviewed publication, service on counseling boards/offices
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial LPC license held under 24 months: 1.67 clock hours per month (rounded up) for the first renewal, at least 6 in ethics.
rules.audit_note: Mandatory random audit of 10% of LPC renewals; proof due within 30 days of the notice. Keep documentation 3 years after the renewal period.
rules.notes: At least 75% of hours must be real-time interactive (in person or live interactive technology); recorded/self-study counts only toward the remaining 25%. Licenses expire biennially on July 31 of the renewal year.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by NBCC, CRCC, NAADAC, ASCA, APA or the Alabama Department of Mental Health; formal graduate academic coursework; up to 3 hours for presenting, peer-reviewed publication or service on counseling boards/offices
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation 3 years after the renewal period.
rules.notes: Associate Licensed Counselors renew annually by the anniversary of license issuance. At least 75% of hours must be real-time interactive.
